core_image.text: 全体から分かれた、ひとかけら
core_image.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 160"><rect width="240" height="160" fill="white"/><g fill="none" stroke="black" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="40" y="60" width="80" height="60"/><polygon points="150,60 190,60 190,100 170,100 150,80"/><line x1="120" y1="60" x2="120" y2="120" stroke-dasharray="3 3"/></g><text x="170" y="140" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle" fill="black" stroke="none">ひとかけら</text></svg>

etymology: 古いフランス語 piece(かけら) → 全体から取れた一片・ひとかけら → (数えられない名詞を数える)1つ(a piece of advice) → (作品の)1点・(機械の)部品

en_definitions.text: a part of something that has been broken or cut off; a single item of a type of thing; a work of art or music.

cautions: a piece of A=1つのA(不可算名詞を数える:a piece of advice [information / furniture])
in pieces=ばらばらに/fall to pieces=ばらばらになる
a piece of cake=(口語)朝飯前
